name: azure-event-hubs
description: Expert knowledge for Azure Event Hubs development including troubleshooting, best practices, decision making, architecture & design patterns, limits & quotas, security, configuration, integrations & coding patterns, and deployment. Use when using Kafka clients, Flink/Spark, geo-replication, Entra ID/RBAC auth, or Event Hubs Capture/Avro, and other Azure Event Hubs related development tasks. Not for Azure Service Bus (use azure-service-bus), Azure Event Grid (use azure-event-grid), Azure Notification Hubs (use azure-notification-hubs), Azure Web PubSub (use azure-web-pubsub).
